items.title: Literal reading
items.instead: Write the exact condition. Put boundary cases in criteria. Split implied intent into two questions.

items.title: Math, counting, numeric precision
items.instead: Count and calculate in code. Ask one Noul per item, then sum. Prefer named buckets over hex/RGB.

items.title: Date and time comparison
items.instead: Extract parts as Choice (month, day, year, or not stated). Assemble and compare in code.

items.title: Multi-hop indirection
items.instead: Reduce hops. Point at the relevant state with a backticked path.

items.title: Large state full of irrelevant detail
items.instead: Filter first. Send only what the question needs.

items.title: Adversarial content
items.instead: State is data, not hostile by default. Write precise criteria and test injections.

items.title: Contradictory instructions vs criteria
items.instead: Treat criteria as an extension of the instruction. Do not map true to no.

items.title: Structural invariants are not guaranteed
items.instead: Do not assume P(yes)+P(not yes)=1 across two Nouls. Do not reuse a Noul threshold on a Choice.

items.title: Generation
items.instead: Do not chain Choices to spell text. Use a generative model, or turn extraction into a Choice over candidates.
